Hello! Thank you for the appeal! Please draw my character, 「Tsuu」. I would like for her to be peacefully reading outdoors surrounded by nature. You can design a new outfit for her if you like.

https://www.deviantart.com/stash/2dtelr14cgy

Hello I saw your appeal and am really glad you asking how her fox ears and tail work. So normally there hidden but in times when she uses her 

Now I want to request an illustration of her, you have the freedom to draw her in way you want but my only request is you give her normal eyebrows. 
Here's some of my favorite references of her.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/mobile/folders/1gtLHqL3UJYvo25V6JQSofwxZuBVCuGQs?usp=docs_web&sort=13&direction=a

Hello! Thank you for the appeal! My friend was very happy that you like her character Carmen, so I am requesting a drawing of Carmen on her behalf!

Carmen De Fiore (27 years old, 186 cm) is an quiet but eccentric florist. They are greatly interested in art as a concept, and often frequent art museums, concerts, gardens, and anywhere else that could be considered a place of beauty. They have a tendency to value qualities that most people would see as surface level or coincidental, causing their praise and criticism to come across enigmatic. They are lanky with dark blue hair, freckles, and a neutral expression contrasted by rather expressive eyes. They tend to wear traditionally formal clothes but in informal ways (straps and ties hanging loosely, shirts unbuttoned, sleeves/pants rolled up). They often wear floral accessories.

You have a very good understanding of Carmen's character, so I will leave the pose and details of the composition up to you! Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1T8RF1yRL7006iZdPmzmXH1bdsEiJgGf9/view?usp=sharing

Greetings, it's nice to meet you.

Thank you for your interest in my character, Lara. I am glad you like her!

If you would like to draw her in her adventuring outfit, please feel free to do so!
She often times doesn't have her sword in her hand. In fact, she usually keeps it elsewhere and can summon it into her hand whenever she wants to.
Maybe you could draw her holding a map or something else this time?

You can decide on any of the details, what you would like to show and the scene.
Please just make sure to keep the floral pattern on her qipao and the silver necklace. The rest is all up to you!

Thank you very much once more.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1KxxMdXmTTBQkscVnDUE9m2Ao6C2CscfA

Hello. Thank you for the appeal. Please draw my OC in any pose and expression. Thank you.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16UKjwclaHW7NtQ_49LIe1kr-L2rtawv0

It's been really cold lately, now that I think of it... So sure! Thank you for the appeal, Sato! Your artstyle looks perfect for the idea you presented!

I'd like to see the requested character, Jhemi, drawn in some cozy winter clothes! He actually doesn't like the cold at all- He grew up in a very very warm area! I'll leave the design and pose and everything up to you, but I'd like to see some visible fluff on the outfit! And maybe a beret hat or beanie, too...

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DK56UglJX5nbz4Oy2dWZQyiDZLQvqQiu

Hi! Thank you for your appeal! Your art is very cute! I would be happy if you could draw these two OCs, they belong to me and my friend.

🌠 [A] 172cm. Blue dragon. Cool and friendly. A responsible guy who always has a calm smile. He relaxes around [B] and likes to tease him.

🔥 [B] 165cm. Red phoenix. Confident, noisy, rude. His ears are feathers like a bird and he has a scar on his lip. He is a troublemaker and likes to bother [A].

Reference images: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18OTFdG_uZnTpsKHXPqsh4nlK600ReAA3

They are freerunners who live in the neon district! The two of them are rivals and romantic partners.

I will leave the pose and details up to you! Please draw freely. You can simplify or change the outfits. If there are any problems, feel free to decline!

Thank you for considering..! 💞

Hello! Thank you for the appeal! ^^

I like the idea you provided, so please go ahead and draw accordingly!

The lonely expression is fitting, but i'd prefer a lonely smile, if thats OK!

I will put the description below:
きょうや is a quiet guy who is always smiling. His smile is very sly. It's as if he is hiding something, but people usually do not notice, as he is very friendly at first impression. But in truth, he's a kind person who just likes to tease others.

His emoji is 🌗, he is associated with the moon.

Thank you very much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DBFnD_XEZPjTto4HpulTekYFfBZU2E4s

Hello! Thank you for the appeal!

I think your art is very cute, and I would love to see my OC, Yuel, drawn in your style!

Yuel is 21 years old. He's a grumpy tsundere. He tries to act serious, but he gets embarrassed and flustered easily. He likes reading books and eating sweets. He doesn't like wearing feminine clothes, but he wears them sometimes because his boyfriend convinces him to do it.

Here are some references of him:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WBga2HYhR4EMRU5An-u5o3j4Qj5hHMeu?usp=sharing

Please feel free to draw him in whatever outfit you like, in whatever pose you want. You can choose the background too!

Hello! Thank you for the appeal! It makes me happy to know that you like my characters (o･ω･o)

I would like for you to draw my two characters. They are two people who are close friends.

https://sta.sh/212s3oc6niap
Emil is quiet, patient and kind. Aidan is happy, optimistic and lively. They both work in the same office and live together in the same place. They are a contrasting pair, but they get on well!

Please draw the scenario that you described! I'd be excited to see it, especially if it involves a cat!!

Thank you so much! (≧▽≦)/

https://sta.sh/01ixaqyu9pvv

Hello! Thank you very much for your interest in Ollivander!! 

He is a sickly and delicate boy, who has trouble breathing and is slowly losing his ability to see. Whin it was first announced that Ollivander’s sickness would probably kill him before he reached adulthood, his father left. Ollivander’s uncle (his mother’s younger brother) often comes by to spent time with him.

Despite the pain and troubles he has been through, he is trying to stay positive! He loves his mother and his uncle very much, goes outside often (though he sometimes has to be carried) and enjoys the smell of flowers! His uncle tries to grow lots of pleasant smelling flowers for him

Thank you again! I look forward to seeing your amazing work!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-nWRzlXsDFDZCWeIxtY-zKmZjhcoFI6I

Hello! Thank you for your lovely appeal! c:

Your art is so nice, and I am so happy that you like my Kazuko, and that you find her cute!

I like to think she a cute woman who has the warm, loving aura of a caring mom (she has twin children! A boy and a girl) and is the devoted, loving wife to her childhood best friend~ <3
She like snacks, gardening, singing, and writing novels.

I would love for you to draw her! Please draw her as you would like!

I have a bunch of references in the attached Google folder that I hope will give you any extra inspiration you may want or need. Thank you again!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WT_0x8xOE72VhtJCQQxZbCs4RuU0RKpl?usp=drive_link

Hello thank you for your appeal and interest in my oc. I have no particular request so feel free to draw whatever you'd like.

Thank you!!

https://sta.sh/223zbc2fi63m

Hello, it's lovely to meet you!
Thank you for your interest! Your style is lovely, and the idea you suggested sounded really nice! I would like to take you up on your offer, if you are still interested.

Characters:
- Eric is an irritable but capable Prince with a strong sense of justice. He is strong in formal social settings but weak in casual social settings. He can lose his composure around cute things like animals.
- Nathan is a skilled Knight who is devoted to his duty. His devotion comes from his secret feelings for the Prince. He appears optimistic and friendly, but he is secretive and distrusts most others.

Relationship: 
Childhood friends with a very strong bond. Eric is often stressed and turns to Nathan for comfort. Nathan is wholly devoted to Eric and would do anything for him.

I'm happy to leave everything to your discretion! You may use whichever outfits appeal to you most, or put them in something new if you prefer.

You are free to decline if the request does not appeal to you for any reason.
Thank you for the opportunity!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1oUfgiNJLB4kqdsrUFtdGn9Pw44v2RcRz?usp=drive_link

I saw that you'd be ok with drawing pairings, so I'd like for you to draw these two if its fine by you

References:

Hello! I received an appeal from you a little while ago. Could you please draw my OC? You can find the full reference material in the URL at the bottom of the request!

Key design notes:
- She has pink drill twintails with large white ribbons
- Her eyes are purple
- When her mouth is open, you can see a single fang
- Her chest should be kept flat

She has a prankster personality, and is a little like a magical girl. She uses music to generate positive energy to fight evil creatures made of negative energy.

There are various costumes in the reference material. In particular, could you please draw her in one of the dresses pictured here? https://drive.google.com/file/d/1pvcxQzHK9pZbsNGd-EFOx7xo18mE0u6b/view
Since they're simple drawings, it's ok to interpret it however you like. I'll leave the pose and everything else to you..!

Thank you for your consideration! Sorry if anything sounds strange in the machine translation.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1Jj_gVfYjNFrguhoslkzE_Mm5oFCB8xAD

Hello, nice to meet you! Thank you for your appeal and your kind words about my character Ed. I would love for you to draw them and include space motifs in the drawing! I think your art style is very cute and perfect to illustrate Ed's cuteness! 

I've attached details about Ed and past commissions reflecting their personality. Please draw them as you envision, and thank you again for your appeal!

I would like to request an illustration of my male maid character. Pose and expression can all be decided by you!

Thanks so much!

https://imgur.com/a/maid-clint0-references-n465HIU

Hello sensei! Thank you for your appeal and your interest in my bird girl. I would be happy if you drew her!

Yunha is a peppy, gentle, and friendly bird person. She can come off as a bit of an airhead at times, but she is generally well liked. She has yellow eyes and blushes orange. Her bird is the zebra finch. Please do not forget the markings under her eyes. She likes birds and orange fruits.

Thank you!

https://toyhou.se/23526498.yunha-zeebie

Hello! Thank you so much for your appeal, Sato-san! I would love to request my character 帆九斗!

△ 169 cm
△ 29 years old (appears 25)
△ He is a vampire, and a very optimistic and kind person on the outside, but reserved and emotional inside. 
△ He prefers wearing black, orange, red and dark blues. You may draw him in any outfit you like.
△ He usually wears oversized shorts, pants, shirts and jackets. Other times he wears dresses and makeup. He can also be dressed in office wear if mixed with pajamas. 
△ He's okay at talking to others, but prefers to keep to himself in the dark of his room. 
△ He has one black prosthetic eye (right) and one naturally red eye (left). He has two vertical moles under his left eye. 
△ His hair is black, messy, and very fluffy. 
△ Some of his themes include: eyes, video games, dating sims, computers, other generic "shut-in" hobbies. He does gymnastics in his spare time and is flexible. He is from a modern setting.

Thank you so much for your time!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ple7MuglQVHQT-J_y5Ipt-HMPtBb_akl

Hello!！I really like your art and I want to commission you to draw something for him

I like this picture of yours:https://46kuji.tumblr.com/post/751520496558981120
Can you draw a similar style?

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kBrUuZ5XDmHJ8sKx4IRzLEosvdZEMjmn

This is a near-future world. He is 19 years old. He lost consciousness and killed his family by accident when he was 18 and since then he has been in a state of confusion and remorse. But he doesn't want to die, he sees death as an irresponsible escape.He used to be a very righteous and cheerful man.He is humble and cautious towards people. He sees himself as an object.

モチーフ：逆さ男（REVERSE），正義（SEIGI）、犠牲（GISEI）

sato様、初めまして！アピールありがとうございました。素敵な絵を楽しく拝見させて頂きました！綺麗な絵柄に惹かれて、可能ならばsato様に私の自キャラのイラストを依頼したいと思っております。

【依頼内容】
キャラと服装の参照は下記のURLをご覧ください。和風ファンタジーの設定に神社で務めているエルフ族の先輩後輩の二人です。長いお付き合いですから、今はとても親密な関係です。

【１】
後輩(短髪の子、177cm)。見た目が優しくて落ち着いてる性格ですが、中身はちょっとツンデレで、少し生意気なタイプです。お世話焼き。右目は茶色、左目は青い色。

【２】
先輩 (ポニーテールの子、180cm)。表はクールと無口、裏は照れ屋さんの性格です。いつも他の人に世話を焼かれるのでなんか面倒くさいな人。耳の飾りは左耳の方だけに付けてお願い致します。

可能ならば、この2人で和風のモチーフを入れて、一枚のイラストをお願い致します。穏やかな雰囲気で描いて頂ければ大変嬉しいです。その他のポーズや構図などはsato様にお任せしたいと思っておりますので、お気軽に描いてください！

もし依頼内容に難しい点か問題点があれば、是非断ってください。
ご検討のほど、宜しくお願い致します。

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zme8Lu3By7Ay44m-CSSQKymAQRRT0M-a?usp=sharing

Hello! I was happy to get your appeal, your art is so cute! I would be happy if you would draw Han

https://toyhou.se/2419562.han

He is a boy, but appears androgynous! He's very happy and playful, but also likes to meditate and travel. The pose and outfit is up to you - but please include his necklace! His world has lots of nature, old ruins and magic, and his motifs are space, the sun, plants, and fire. He is a healer, and has lots of knowledge of medicine and herbs. You can dress him in modern clothing if you like, too, please feel free to draw what is fun!

I especially like this piece that you drew: https://64.media.tumblr.com/5a417916d9dd5da175387412f032c39f/7b987e815a6dce44-2e/s1280x1920/3880a74b3d2d4a7969c4af9f1cd5a97ddeebb6c9.png ! If you want to draw him with a Pokemon, his Pokemon is Altaria, but it is not required! I just saw your Pokemon drawings are very cute! But please draw what you like!

Thank you again!
